selectionMethod: Resource-derived without timing-based tuning: two workers and one x264 thread per worker/active encoder, matching the two-CPU cpuset. No candidate timing screen was run.

concurrencySemantics.H: Two concurrently active segment encoders, one x264 thread each: initial aggregate encoder budget two threads.
concurrencySemantics.F: Two concurrently active segment encoders, one x264 thread each: initial aggregate encoder budget two threads.
concurrencySemantics.R: Two renderer workers; one x264 thread per active encoder. Qualification emitted one non-copy stitcher encoder, so observed active encoding budget was one x264 thread; renderer workers consumed the two-CPU raster budget. Renderer concurrency does not imply two simultaneous encoders.

clock: Fresh process through drawing/rasterization, encoding, required fframes ultrafast edit-list repair, and one final two-thread full-decode validation. Hashing, encoder inspection, cadence, references, and quality are outside the delivered clock.
